tools.name: getPageAsMarkdown
tools.description: Fetch any page on abilitie.com as a markdown document. Returns the main content with chrome stripped — useful for summarization, RAG, or grounding.

path.description: Site-relative path to fetch, e.g. "/" or "/customer-stories".

tools.name: listSitePages
tools.description: List every published page on abilitie.com by parsing the sitemap. Returns an array of absolute URLs.
